mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL increases do not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS declines do not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE spikes do not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO declines do not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% annualized over the past 3 months, the combined effect signals tightening monetary conditions and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL > 2% annualized increase over 3 months
regime_hint: tightening monetary conditions with inflationary pressure
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: When Real Final Sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.5% over the past month, the combined effect signals weakening demand and labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases > 1% and UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: weakening demand and labor market distress
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4%), an increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low unemployment with strong job growth
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market upturns.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion (GDPC1 increasing), a decrease in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% signals a potential supply-demand imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the joint condition does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.
